properties.name: court basin
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1911: 50; Christofle 1930, plan p. 59
properties.description: basin 3.65 x 2.60 m in the middle of the north side of the great court, opposite the entrance

properties.name: House of the Gardens (Maison aux Jardinières)
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1897 I: Pl. XXXVII and fig. 36 (printed p. 224); BCB 1905: fig. 40 (pp. 88-92)
properties.description: central well ringed by near-semicircular stone planters

properties.name: House of Sertius (Maison de Sertius)
properties.plan_source: Plate XXI (labelled “Maison de Sertius”) - Ballu 1903; Germain 1969, fig. 6
properties.description: fountain at W end of peristyle

properties.name: House of Sertius (Maison de Sertius)
properties.plan_source: Plate XXI (labelled “Maison de Sertius”) - Ballu 1903; Germain 1969, fig. 6
properties.description: basin, impluvium in atrium

properties.name: House of the Hermaphrodite (Maison de l'Hermaphrodite)
properties.plan_source: Boeswillwald, Cagnat and Ballu 1905, fig. 152; Germain 1969, fig. 7
properties.description: square fountain at the west end of the long basin, in the middle opening between the hall and the court (BCB 1905 fig. 152, a; Germain 1969 fig. 7, 79)

properties.name: House of the Hermaphrodite (Maison de l'Hermaphrodite)
properties.plan_source: Boeswillwald, Cagnat and Ballu 1905, fig. 152; Germain 1969, fig. 7
properties.description: long central basin with gutter inside the colonnade, the length of the long side; drawn by BCB 1905 and Germain 1969, omitted by Ballu 1903

properties.name: House of the Hermaphrodite (Maison de l'Hermaphrodite)
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1903, pl. XXIII; Boeswillwald, Cagnat and Ballu 1905, fig. 152
properties.description: framed rectangular basin in the south room (BCB room 10), drawn by Ballu 1903 pl. XXIII and BCB 1905 fig. 152; Germain 1969 fig. 7 shows a plain room with mosaic 81 here instead

properties.name: peristyle basin
properties.plan_source: Christofle 1930: 60-61; Christofle 1930, plan p. 59

properties.name: piscina of the peristyle
properties.plan_source: round-2 drawing (Sep 30, 2026), imagery; BCB 1905, fig. 166 (carrés 73 and 82); Ballu 1897b: 229-230
properties.description: long basin of blue granite with a semicircular north end, walls 0.76 m high, nine pink marble columns on its rim (Ballu 1897b: 229-230, fig. 38); the rim traced on the semicircular dark ring of the Google imagery

properties.name: Oval pool
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1926, folding plate (Rapport 1925); round-2 drawing (Oct 1, 2026)
properties.description: oval pool of the baths, the north one of the two pools Germain gives the baths, "au nord et au sud", with floors of terracotta mosaic (1969: 115, no. 172), on Ballu's plan, and the dark oval of it shows right where the plan puts it on the satellite imagery, so certain

properties.name: Pool in the south apse room
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1926, folding plate (Rapport 1925); round-2 drawing (Oct 1, 2026)
properties.description: pool in the south apse room of the baths, the south one of the two pools Germain gives the baths, "au nord et au sud", with floors of terracotta mosaic (1969: 115, no. 172), opening off the frigidarium through an opening with two step lines in it on Ballu's plan, and the dark hollow of it shows right here on the satellite imagery, so certain

properties.name: Basin in the north part of the west 1925 room
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1926, folding plate (Rapport 1925); round-2 drawing (Oct 1, 2026)
properties.description: concrete basin in the north part of the west 1925 room, Ballu's second room, 6.15 by 3 m inside with walls 0.80 m thick (Ballu 1925: 36), the inner one of the two rectangles his plan draws one inside the other, and I can't make it out on the satellite imagery, so uncertain

properties.name: Basin with a rounded south end
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1926, folding plate (Rapport 1925); round-2 drawing (Oct 1, 2026)
properties.description: basin with a rounded south end in the room south of the cross wall of the heated rooms, on Ballu's plan, and there's a dark hollow with a rounded end about here on the satellite imagery, though not sharp, so probable

properties.name: Basin in the north-east corner of the north portico of the atrium
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1926, folding plate (Rapport 1925); round-2 drawing (Oct 1, 2026)
properties.description: outlined rectangle about 1.9 by 1.0 m in the north-east corner of the atrium's north portico on Ballu's plan, where Ballu puts the basin that he thought wasn't there originally (1916: 178), and there's a bright block with its own shadow right here on the satellite imagery, so certain

properties.name: well in room 1
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020b: 229, fig. 11.5; round-2 drawing (Oct 2, 2026)
properties.description: well in the fullery room in the north-west corner, a square on Amraoui's plan (her P, *puits*), and Ballu mentions the well in this room (BCTH 1912: 494), and on the ground there's a dark pit right where she puts it with light stone either side, so certain

properties.name: tub compartment a in room 1
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020b: 229, fig. 11.5; round-2 drawing (Oct 2, 2026)
properties.description: the west one of the two fulling tub compartments along the south side of room 1, a terracotta tub inside low stone partitions on Amraoui's plan (her a), one of the two *cuves à foulon* Ballu found in this room (BCTH 1912: 494), and the stone partition along the north side of the two compartments shows on the ground as a light line with its shadow, with a dark hollow inside this one, so certain

properties.name: tub compartment b in room 1
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020b: 229, fig. 11.5; round-2 drawing (Oct 2, 2026)
properties.description: the east one of the two fulling tub compartments in room 1, a smaller tub in its own stone partitions against the wall of room 3 on Amraoui's plan (her b), and its north partition shows on the ground as part of the same light line as compartment a's, so certain

properties.name: well in room 10
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020b: 234, fig. 11.9; Christofle's plan in Wilson 2001: 275, fig. 12.04; round-2 drawing (Sep 29, 2026)
properties.description: well in room 10, the east fullery room, a square curb round the shaft on Amraoui's plan (her P, *puits*) and Christofle's well W, and Ballu lists a well in the two fullery rooms on the north street (BCTH 1912: 494), and on the ground there's a big dark pit with light stone either side, about a quarter of a metre west of where the plans come out, so I've drawn the well and tub d on it, and it's certain

properties.name: tub compartment a in room 9
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020b: 234, fig. 11.9; Christofle's plan in Wilson 2001: 275, fig. 12.04; round-2 drawing (Sep 29, 2026)
properties.description: west tub compartment along the south side of room 9, with a terracotta fulling tub in it on Amraoui's plan (her a) and Christofle's (his A, 0.80 m across inside, Wilson 2001: 276, fig. 12.04), the biggest of the three *cuves à foulon* Ballu found in these two rooms (BCTH 1912: 494); the low stone partition along its north side shows on the ground as a light line with its shadow, a bit under half a metre further north than on Amraoui's plan and a little south of where Christofle has it, in line with the partition of compartment e in room 10, so certain

properties.name: tub compartment b in room 9
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020b: 234, fig. 11.9; Christofle's plan in Wilson 2001: 275, fig. 12.04; round-2 drawing (Sep 29, 2026)
properties.description: east tub compartment of room 9, against the wall of room 10, with a smaller terracotta tub in it (Amraoui's b, Christofle's B, 0.70 m across inside), and its north partition is the same light line as compartment a's, with the hollow of the tub showing as a dark spot, so certain

properties.name: tub compartment d in room 10
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020b: 234, fig. 11.9; Christofle's plan in Wilson 2001: 275, fig. 12.04; round-2 drawing (Sep 29, 2026)
properties.description: tub compartment against the south wall of room 10, just south of the well, with a terracotta tub in it on Amraoui's plan (her d) and Christofle's (his C, 0.70 m across inside), and on the ground there's a dark hollow just south of the well's pit, about a quarter of a metre west of where his tub comes out, like the well, with the light line of a partition on its west side, so certain

properties.name: compartment c in room 10
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020b: 234, fig. 11.9; Christofle's plan in Wilson 2001: 275, fig. 12.04; round-2 drawing (Sep 29, 2026)
properties.description: compartment in the south-west corner of room 10, between the wall of room 9 and tub d, which Amraoui draws with stone partitions but no tub (her c) and Christofle as a concrete floor, so it may be one of the two basins Ballu lists in these rooms (*deux bassins*, BCTH 1912: 494), and its north side is the same light line with its shadow as compartment e's, with the partition between it and tub d fainter, so certain

properties.name: compartment e in room 10
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020b: 234, fig. 11.9; Christofle's plan in Wilson 2001: 275, fig. 12.04; round-2 drawing (Sep 29, 2026)
properties.description: compartment in the north-west corner of room 10, against the wall of room 9, closed off by thin stone partitions on Amraoui's plan (her e) and drawn as a concrete floor by Christofle, so c and e may be Ballu's two basins in these rooms (BCTH 1912: 494), and its south partition shows on the ground as a light line with its shadow, so certain

properties.name: well in room 6
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020b: 234, fig. 11.9; round-2 drawing (Sep 29, 2026)
properties.description: well in room 6, a square shaft with a cross-shaped stone curb round it on Amraoui's plan (her P), one of the two wells Ballu has in the west half of the block (BCTH 1912: 494), and there's a dark pit on the ground right where she puts it, so certain

properties.name: well in room 10
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020a: 134, fig. 4.11; Amraoui 2020b: 235, fig. 11.10; Christofle's plan of the fullery in Wilson 2001: 274, fig. 12.01; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: well of the fullery in room 10, in a square stone curb on Amraoui's plan (her P), and Christofle's well W in the same place, surrounded by low walls like the tub compartments, which Amraoui says kept the clean water from the splashes of the compartments (2020a: 133, fig. 4.9), and on the ground there's a dark patch a bit north of where the plans put it but no clear pit, so probable

properties.name: tub compartment a
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020a: 134, fig. 4.11; Amraoui 2020b: 235, fig. 11.10; Christofle's plan of the fullery in Wilson 2001: 274, fig. 12.01; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: tub compartment a, east of room 9 against the north wall, with a terracotta tub in it on Amraoui's plan and Christofle's tub I (0.84 m across inside, Wilson 2001: 274, fig. 12.01), and on the ground the line of its west wall shows faintly but the compartment itself is just mottled, so probable

properties.name: compartment b
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020a: 134, fig. 4.11; Amraoui 2020b: 235, fig. 11.10; Christofle's plan of the fullery in Wilson 2001: 274, fig. 12.01; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: tub compartment b in the north-east corner of the block, where Amraoui draws the tub as missing and Christofle has his tub J (0.84 m across inside), with a mortared tile floor in its south half on her plan, and on the ground a dark hollow slanting across it, so probable

properties.name: tub compartment c
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020a: 134, fig. 4.11; Amraoui 2020b: 235, fig. 11.10; Christofle's plan of the fullery in Wilson 2001: 274, fig. 12.01; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: compartment c in room 10, north of the well, the one with the stone tub on Amraoui's plan, Christofle's sandstone tub G (0.78 m across inside), and on the ground a dark spot about where the tub would be, so probable

properties.name: tub compartment d
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020a: 134, fig. 4.11; Amraoui 2020b: 235, fig. 11.10; Christofle's plan of the fullery in Wilson 2001: 274, fig. 12.01; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: tub compartment d against the east wall, east of c, with a terracotta tub on Amraoui's plan and Christofle's tub H (0.85 m across inside), and nothing clear on the ground beyond the light line of the partition west of it, so probable

properties.name: tub compartment f
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020a: 134, fig. 4.11; Amraoui 2020b: 235, fig. 11.10; Christofle's plan of the fullery in Wilson 2001: 274, fig. 12.01; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: tub compartment f against the east wall south of d, the long one with the mortared tile floor on Amraoui's plan, with a terracotta tub in it, Christofle's tub F (0.82 m across inside), and on the ground the light line of the partition on its west side shows, so probable

properties.name: tub compartment e
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020a: 134, fig. 4.11; Amraoui 2020b: 235, fig. 11.10; Christofle's plan of the fullery in Wilson 2001: 274, fig. 12.01; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: tub compartment e against the fullery's south wall, east of g, with a small terracotta tub on Amraoui's plan and Christofle's tub E (0.50 m across inside, the smallest), and the light line with its shadow along its north side shows on the ground, so probable

properties.name: tub compartment g
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020a: 134, fig. 4.11; Amraoui 2020b: 235, fig. 11.10; Christofle's plan of the fullery in Wilson 2001: 274, fig. 12.01; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: tub compartment g against the fullery's south wall in the south-west corner of room 10, with a terracotta tub on Amraoui's plan and Christofle's tub D (0.65 m across inside), and the light line along its north side shows on the ground, so probable

properties.name: compartment i
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020a: 134, fig. 4.11; Amraoui 2020b: 235, fig. 11.10; Christofle's plan of the fullery in Wilson 2001: 274, fig. 12.01; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: compartment i in room 8, the big one south of j and k against the middle wall, where Amraoui draws the tub as missing and Christofle has his tub B (0.80 m across inside); on her plan its east side toward room 10 is a thin partition line between the orthostat blocks and its south side the thin partition jutting west from the wall of room 10, and on the ground there's a bright patch of stone over its middle and the dark band of that partition along its south side, so probable

properties.name: tub compartment h
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020a: 134, fig. 4.11; Amraoui 2020b: 235, fig. 11.10; Christofle's plan of the fullery in Wilson 2001: 274, fig. 12.01; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: tub compartment h in the south-west corner of the fullery, against the middle wall and the fullery's south wall, with a terracotta tub on Amraoui's plan and Christofle's tub C (0.77 m across inside), its north side the thin partition that juts west from the wall of room 10, which shows on the ground as a dark band running on west toward the middle wall, so probable

properties.name: tub compartment j
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020a: 134, fig. 4.11; Amraoui 2020b: 235, fig. 11.10; Christofle's plan of the fullery in Wilson 2001: 274, fig. 12.01; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: tub compartment j in room 8 against the middle wall, with a terracotta tub on Amraoui's plan, Christofle's tub A (0.68 m across inside), and on the ground a bright patch of stone over this part of room 8 but no partition I can make out, so probable

properties.name: compartment k
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020a: 134, fig. 4.11; Amraoui 2020b: 235, fig. 11.10; Christofle's plan of the fullery in Wilson 2001: 274, fig. 12.01; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: compartment k in room 8, east of j, the one compartment of the fullery without a tub, which Amraoui says can't have been where everyone rinsed (2020a: 135), and on the ground the bright patch of room 8 runs over it, so probable

properties.name: well in room 3
properties.plan_source: Amraoui 2020a: 134, fig. 4.11; Amraoui 2020b: 235, fig. 11.10; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: well in room 3, in a square curb on Amraoui's plan (her P), in the west part of the room, one of the wells of the houses that she says had no low walls round them, unlike the fullery's (2020a: 133), and on the ground there's a dark spot near where she puts it but nothing I'd call a pit, so probable

properties.name: well in the peristyle
properties.plan_source: Ballu, Rapport 1923: 43 (plan), 45-46; Ballu, Rapport 1922: 47-53; Germain 1969: 81, fig. 10; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026), set on the wall lines of the imagery
properties.description: the well in the middle of the peristyle's court, 1.40 m across with a curb 0.52 m thick, dug out to 6 m without finding anything (Ballu 1922: 52; 1923: 46), on his plan as two circles, and on the ground a round dark pit right there, so certain

properties.name: well in the east gallery
properties.plan_source: Ballu, Rapport 1923: 43 (plan), 45-46; Ballu, Rapport 1922: 47-53; Germain 1969: 81, fig. 10; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026), set on the wall lines of the imagery
properties.description: the well in the east gallery, 0.65 m across on Ballu's figure, at the south end of the room he puts south of his room of 4.20 m (1922: 51), in the wing with a well (1923: 46), a circle on his plan, and on the ground nothing I can pick out, so probable

properties.name: cistern east of the baths
properties.plan_source: Ballu, Rapport 1923: 43 (plan), 45-46; Ballu, Rapport 1922: 50-52; Germain 1969: 81, fig. 10; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: the cistern east of the baths, Ballu's vast cistern 13 m wide and 14 m long, with only part of its concrete floor left, 12 by 6.35 m (1922: 52), drawn as an outline on his plan without its north side; on the ground it's the big sunken rectangle, the floor's light patch in its south half, with clear walls on the south, east and west, and the east wall's inner shadow runs on to about 14 m from the south side, so the north side is put there, on his length, though no north wall shows, probable

properties.name: settling basin (north)
properties.plan_source: Ballu, Rapport 1923: 43 (plan), 45-46; Ballu, Rapport 1922: 50-52; Germain 1969: 81, fig. 10; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: the northern of the three narrow basins with thick walls that ran along the caldaria's east wall, about a metre wide, which Ballu took for settling basins (1922: 52), an outline on his plan, and on the ground the strip between the caldaria and the cistern is light stone with no edges I can follow, so probable

properties.name: settling basin (middle)
properties.plan_source: Ballu, Rapport 1923: 43 (plan), 45-46; Ballu, Rapport 1922: 50-52; Germain 1969: 81, fig. 10; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: the middle and longest of the three narrow basins along the caldaria's east wall (Ballu 1922: 52), an outline on his plan, and on the ground the strip shows but not its divisions, so probable

properties.name: settling basin (south)
properties.plan_source: Ballu, Rapport 1923: 43 (plan), 45-46; Ballu, Rapport 1922: 50-52; Germain 1969: 81, fig. 10; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: the southern of the three narrow basins along the caldaria's east wall, with a rounded corner on Ballu's plan (1922: 52), and on the ground the strip shows but not this basin's own edges, so probable

properties.name: concrete basin in the atrium
properties.plan_source: Ballu, Rapport 1923: 43 (plan), 45-46; Ballu, Rapport 1922: 47-53; Germain 1969: 81, fig. 10; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026), set on the wall lines of the imagery
properties.description: the concrete basin in the atrium's court, of which only a half-round part was left, fed by the fountain in front of the west side of the north walk (Ballu 1922: 48); Ballu draws it dotted, restored, in the west part of the court, so uncertain, and its size is his

properties.name: traces of the fountain in the atrium
properties.plan_source: Ballu, Rapport 1923: 43 (plan), 45-46; Ballu, Rapport 1922: 47-53; Germain 1969: 81, fig. 10; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026), set on the wall lines of the imagery
properties.description: the traces of the fountain Ballu found in front of the west side of the atrium's north walk, which emptied into the concrete basin of the court (1922: 48), drawn as a hatched patch in the west walk on his plan, and on the ground a light block of stone there, so probable

properties.name: horseshoe-shaped structure with a drain
properties.plan_source: Ballu, Rapport 1923: 43 (plan), 45-46; Ballu, Rapport 1922: 50-52; Germain 1969: 81, fig. 10; round-2 drawing (Oct 3, 2026)
properties.description: the little horseshoe-shaped construction with a drain through it, in the court west of the cold pool (Ballu 1922: 52), on his plan as a small outline, and on the ground nothing clear, so probable on the plan's word

properties.name: square well in the atrium
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1911a (Sept années): 74, plan of the house, with his description 72-73 (first published in his report on the 1906 excavations, Ballu 1907: 261-262); round-2 drawing (Oct 4, 2026), set on the walls as the imagery shows them
properties.description: the square well of the atrium (1911a: 73), the square with a round head beside it that his plan draws in the north part of the atrium, though his text puts the well in the front part and the outlet at the north end of the paving, so one of the two has the ends the other way round; nothing reads on the imagery, so probable on his plan

properties.name: latrines
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1911a (Sept années): 74, plan of the house, and 76, plan and section of the latrines, with his description 72 and their sizes and seats in his report on the 1906 excavations, Ballu 1907: 262; round-2 drawing (Oct 4, 2026), set on the walls as the imagery shows them
properties.description: the latrines in the south-east corner, projecting onto the cardo east of the house, to the right as you come in from the street (1911a: 72); Ballu gives them as 2.40 by 1.65 m (he calls the 2.40 the width) with five stone seats pierced with holes of 0.18 m and a channel under them running to the street sewer (1907: 262), and draws them in plan and section (1911a: 76); on the imagery a small walled room with a deep shadow on its north side, so certain

properties.name: horseshoe basin in the south portico (Ballu 1910)
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1911a: 33, plan of the complex ('Timgad, Monastère de l'Ouest', Timgad, the Western Monastery, 1910); round-2 drawing (Oct 4, 2026)
properties.description: the horseshoe-shaped basin that Ballu's 1910 plan of the complex draws in the room south of the court, open to the north, about 2.7 m across (Ballu 1911a: 33); the room is the south portico on Meunier's croquis, which doesn't draw the basin, and nothing of it shows on the imagery, so it's here on Ballu's word alone, uncertain, its place taken from his plan set on the whole complex and good to about half a metre

properties.name: basin against the south wall of the south portico (Ballu 1910)
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1911a: 33, plan of the complex ('Timgad, Monastère de l'Ouest', Timgad, the Western Monastery, 1910); round-2 drawing (Oct 4, 2026)
properties.description: the outlined rectangle Ballu's 1910 plan draws against the south wall of the room south of the court, east of the horseshoe basin (Ballu 1911a: 33), an outlined rectangle that I read as a basin ??; not on Meunier's croquis and nothing shows on the imagery, so uncertain, from his plan alone

properties.name: basin or pit in the south-east room (place uncertain)
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1912: 495 (BCTH; offprint p. 33), the room as Courtois 1951 and Wilson 2001 draw it; round-2 drawing (Oct 5, 2026)
properties.description: Ballu gives this room one basin but doesn't say where (BCTH 1912: 495); the only thing in the room on the ground is a very dark pit, about 0.8 by 1 m, about 3.5 m from the east wall and 2 m from the south wall, which could be it, but it could as easily be a well or a later hole, so uncertain, and the outline is notional

properties.name: well in the fullery room (place uncertain)
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1912: 493 (BCTH; offprint p. 31), the room as Courtois 1951 and Wilson 2001 draw it; round-2 drawing (Oct 4, 2026)
properties.description: Ballu gives this room a well but doesn't say where (BCTH 1912: 493); there's a very dark pit on the ground here, about 1 by 2 m, against the north end of the short wall in the room, which is the likeliest spot for it, but it could as easily be one of the vats, so uncertain, and its size is notional

properties.name: square limestone basin in the atrium (Ballu, 2.10 m a side)
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1909: 94-95 (BCTH; offprint pp. 22-23, the report on the 1908 excavations) and 1911a (Sept années): 67-68; the feature as the satellite imagery shows it; round-2 drawing (Oct 6, 2026)
properties.description: Ballu's big square limestone basin in good condition, 2.10 m a side (*un grand bassin en calcaire carré en bon état, de 2 m. 10 de côté*, a big square limestone basin in good condition, 2.10 m a side, 1911a: 67), with a kind of stone pipe pierced at mid-height in the middle of its north wall, once topped by a marble cap with a pine cone, a fountain with a jet (1911a: 67; 1909: 94); on the ground two light walls with their shadows and the west and east walls, about 2.7 m across outside both ways, in the south-west corner of the court, which makes the inside about 2.1 m square, with a dark blob inside near the north wall that may be the pipe; Courtois draws it about half a metre further east; probable

properties.name: well in the west room of the third row
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1912: 493 (BCTH; offprint p. 31) for what was in the room; placed on the dark pit or patch the satellite imagery shows; round-2 drawing (Oct 13, 2026)
properties.description: a round black pit about 0.9 m across with a light ring round it, the way a well's curb shows, in the west room of the third row; Ballu gives one of the west part's two long rooms a well and a basin (*dont une avec puits et bassin*, one of them with a well and basin, BCTH 1912: 493, offprint p. 31), and this is the west long room, so I'd take it for his well, probable since he doesn't say where in the room it was

properties.name: well in the third room of the third row
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1912: 493 (BCTH; offprint p. 31) for what was in the room; placed on the dark pit or patch the satellite imagery shows; round-2 drawing (Oct 13, 2026)
properties.description: a round black pit about 0.9 m across with a light ring round it, in the third room of the third row, inside Ballu's 15 m room of the east part, which he gives a well and two large fulling vessels (BCTH 1912: 493, offprint p. 31); the ring reads like a well's curb rather than a vessel, so probable as his well

properties.name: basin in the west room of the north row (place uncertain)
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1912: 493 (BCTH; offprint p. 31) for what was in the room; placed on the dark pit or patch the satellite imagery shows; round-2 drawing (Oct 13, 2026)
properties.description: a dark patch about 1.6 by 0.9 m near the north wall in the west room of the north row, ending about 0.4 m short of it, with a light block just south of it; it's the only thing in the west long room besides the well that could be Ballu's basin (BCTH 1912: 493, offprint p. 31), but the dark could as easily be the shadow of that block, so uncertain, and I've drawn it the size of the dark patch

properties.name: vat in the west room of the south row (place uncertain)
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1912: 493 (BCTH; offprint p. 31) for what was in the room; placed on the dark pit or patch the satellite imagery shows; round-2 drawing (Oct 13, 2026)
properties.description: a round black pit about 0.7 m across with a light patch just east of it, in the west room of the south row, inside Ballu's paved east-west room with its two vats (BCTH 1912: 493, offprint p. 31); it could be one of them sunk in the floor, but nothing shows of the second, so uncertain

properties.name: vat or basin in the third room of the south row (place uncertain)
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1912: 493 (BCTH; offprint p. 31) for what was in the room; placed on the dark pit or patch the satellite imagery shows; round-2 drawing (Oct 13, 2026)
properties.description: a round black pit about 0.7 m across with a light block just north-west of it and a dark streak running off to the south-west, in the third room of the south row, inside Ballu's east-west room of the east part with its basin and terracotta vat (BCTH 1912: 493, offprint p. 31); it could be either, so uncertain

properties.name: the big well of Ballu's atrium
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1912: 494 (BCTH; offprint p. 32) for the well; placed on the round black pit the satellite imagery shows; Wilson 2001 (fig. 12.08, p. 279) draws the installation here too; round-2 drawing (Oct 13, 2026)
properties.description: a round black pit about 0.9 m across in the room with the curved wall, the shaft of Ballu's big well (*grand puits*, Ballu 1912: 494 (BCTH; offprint p. 32)) in his atrium, with the half-round wall standing a metre north of it; it's the darkest spot in the block on the satellite imagery and Wilson draws the installation here, so certain

properties.name: pit or basin against the east strip's wall, fourth room of the third row
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1912: 494 (BCTH; offprint p. 32) for the wells and vats of this half; placed on the dark hole or patch the satellite imagery shows, which no plan draws; round-2 drawing (Oct 13, 2026)
properties.description: a black hole about 0.7 m across against the west face of the east strip's wall, in the fourth room of the third row, with a bright slab just north of it; it has a twin against the east wall across the east room at the same height, so the two look like a pair of pits or basins with their covers, and Ballu gives this half of the house wells and vats (Ballu 1912: 494 (BCTH; offprint p. 32)); uncertain, since I can't tell a pit from a basin here

properties.name: pit or basin against the east wall, east room of the third row
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1912: 494 (BCTH; offprint p. 32) for the wells and vats of this half; placed on the dark hole or patch the satellite imagery shows, which no plan draws; round-2 drawing (Oct 13, 2026)
properties.description: a black hole about 0.7 m across against the east wall, in the east room of the third row, north part, with a bright slab just north of it; it has a twin on the far side of the east strip's wall at the same height, so the two look like a pair of pits or basins with their covers, and Ballu gives this half of the house wells and vats (Ballu 1912: 494 (BCTH; offprint p. 32)); uncertain, since I can't tell a pit from a basin here

properties.name: basin or vat against the south wall, east room of the south row
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1912: 494 (BCTH; offprint p. 32) for the wells and vats of this half; placed on the dark hole or patch the satellite imagery shows, which no plan draws; round-2 drawing (Oct 13, 2026)
properties.description: a big black patch about 1.4 by 1.3 m against the south wall in the east room of the south row, darker and wider than the wall's shadow band; it could be a deep basin or vat sunk by the wall, which fits Ballu's vats in this half of the house (Ballu 1912: 494 (BCTH; offprint p. 32)), or the shadow of a taller stretch of the wall, so uncertain

properties.name: basin or vat against the south wall, fourth room of the south row
properties.plan_source: Ballu 1912: 494 (BCTH; offprint p. 32) for the wells and vats of this half; placed on the dark hole or patch the satellite imagery shows, which no plan draws; round-2 drawing (Oct 13, 2026)
properties.description: a dark rectangle about 1 by 1.1 m with light rims west and south of it, in the fourth room of the south row a metre up from the south wall and a metre east of the partition, with a bright spot just north of it; it reads as a basin or vat sunk in the floor, which fits Ballu's vats (Ballu 1912: 494 (BCTH; offprint p. 32)); uncertain
